_comment: Cross-runtime parity vectors for the recipient email hash. Consumed by BOTH tests/newsletter/test_hash_parity.py (Python: store.email_hash) AND tests/api/hash_parity.test.js (JS: unsubscribe.js hashEmail). If either implementation drifts on salt / normalization / algorithm / truncation, that side's test fails against the shared `expected`. This is the guard for the known landmine: a one-sided change to the hash silently breaks every unsubscribe/resubscribe link (sha256(salt:email.strip().lower())[:24]). To add a vector, compute `expected` from the reference formula and add both sides re-run green.
